summary: Lost female hiker near Chapman Campground, Fryingpan Valley; Mountain Rescue Aspen deployed its Matrice 210 drone on its first-ever rescue mission — chief pilot launched at 8:30 p.m., located her via infrared camera, directed the closest ground crew (half a mile away), and the rescue group was walked safely back to the road; hiker uninjured
location: Chapman Campground, Fryingpan Valley, above Ruedi Reservoir, White River NF (~30 mi east of Basalt)
notes: Resolves the parked Chapman-drone lead (date-pinned from the Aspen Times account via both sources: call at 6:20 p.m. Wednesday; ground search launched 7:50 p.m. in dark, thickly wooded, marshy terrain; 18 MRA volunteers; date Wednesday-verified 2018-06-27; both URLs parent-opened live).
